// 3. Observer shock boundary intersection and sonic boom
val obsDx = jetX - observerPos.x
val obsDy = abs(observerPos.y - flightY)
val tanMu = 1.0f / sqrt(machNumber * machNumber - 1f)
val isInsideCone = if (obsDx <= 0f) false else obsDy <= obsDx * tanMu

mystery.en: Why do you NEVER hear a supersonic jet before it passes?

en.title: Doppler Shift & Mach Shock Cones
en.teaser: When an aircraft breaks Mach 1, spherical wavefronts fuse into a conical sonic boom shockwave.

en.hook: Why does a supersonic jet fly in dead silence until a thunderous double boom strikes the ground?
en.math: As flight speed passes Mach 1, sound waves pile up into a conical shock envelope with half-angle arcsin of 1 over Mach, creating a zone of total silence ahead and a violent pressure step at the boundary.
en.question: Can we simulate supersonic Doppler shock cones in Kotlin Multiplatform?
en.code_tip: We integrate moving acoustic wavefronts, calculate the Mach cone angle, and detect ground shock impacts live on Canvas.
en.payoff: Doppler frequency compression and supersonic Mach cones running live in Kotlin.
